## Summary

What does this change and why?

## Checklist

- [ ] `./gradlew lintDebug testDebugUnitTest assembleDebug` passes
- [ ] `python scripts/release/scan_repo.py` reports 0 problems
- [ ] No new permission, analytics, or network code outside the `update` package
- [ ] New user-facing text lives in `strings.xml`
- [ ] Tested on a device or emulator (state which one and which profile)
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated under Unreleased when the change is user-visible

Add before and after images for UI changes. Use demo data only, never your real app list.
